method: Resolve every generated native AbstractModel registry entry to one source definition. For reviewed catalog IDs, require the definition hash to match its mechanics proof. Classify explicit mock/deprecated namespaces and six separately traced companion/ending models. Other definitions remain review queues; registry membership alone does not prove playable availability.
limitations: Reviewed catalog scope retains each family's existing limits, including monster review limited to initial HP plus paraphrased move machines.
This is a model registry inventory, not a certification of all behavior or all game systems.
Epochs, intents, keywords, modes and other non-AbstractModel systems need separate inventories.
Companion and ending identities are classified in the application: never enemies, and the ending is not a combat.
